name: A Faded Journal Page
summary: A Faded Journal Page is an old parchment retrieved from an upstairs chest in Marshal Haggard's secluded home in Elwynn Forest. It serves as a vital clue in unraveling the dark history surrounding Stalvan Mistmantle.

sections.title: Parchment in the Chest
sections.body: Left behind inside an old trunk when retired Marshal Haggard took residence near the eastern border of Elwynn Forest, this weathered parchment sat undisturbed for years. With Haggard's failing eyesight preventing him from deciphering it, the page remained neglected until adventurers digging into the legend of Stalvan Mistmantle retrieved it.

sections.title: The Trail to Darkshire
sections.body: Though Haggard could not read the brittle text, he directed investigators across the river to the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Duskwood. The barkeep, Tavernkeep Smitts, recognized the distinctive handwriting immediately upon examining the page, linking the journal entry directly to the grim saga that haunts the region.

faq.q: Where is the Faded Journal Page found?
faq.answer: The page is discovered inside a chest upstairs in the house near Marshal Haggard, located in eastern Elwynn Forest near the river boundary with Duskwood.

faq.q: Why couldn't Marshal Haggard read the page himself?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is an aging veteran whose eyesight has deteriorated significantly, leaving him nearly blind and unable to decipher the faded script on the parchment.

faq.q: Who recognizes the handwriting on the journal page?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts, the barkeep at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, immediately recognizes the handwriting when presented with the page.

faq.q: What protects the chest containing the page?
faq.answer: Opening the upstairs chest disturbs a hostile Forlorn Spirit that attacks investigators before the page can be safely examined.

angles.text: Uncovering this forgotten record helps solve a long-cold mystery that has troubled townsfolk on both sides of the river between Elwynn and Duskwood.
